monster_races.description_english: He is the Master of the Pits of Angband.  His figure is like a black mountain crowned with lightning.  He rages with everlasting anger, his body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds.  He can never rest from his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the world.  He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul creatures with his evil powers.  Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please him.  His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the two remaining Silmarils forever burning him.  Grond, the mighty Hammer of the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a pulp!

player_ability_source_equivalent: player_property.txt is the actual parser source; no player_ability.txt exists. init.c generates 75 element abilities plus 41 ordinary abilities.

prose_gates.monster: lore_append_flavor appends selected race->text; caller owns known race selection, spoilers and flags. No new knownness queries.
prose_gates.ego: obj-info describe_flavor_text original object_flavor_is_aware/ego and obj->known->ego gates; five domain-owned endpoints referenced.
prose_gates.object_property: obj-info selects known modifiers/flags/elements and appropriate property subtype; rune init excludes internal light/dig/throw/curse-only flags.
prose_gates.player_ability: player-properties selects actual race/class/object/element ability; UI knowledge/shape consumers select appropriate flags before rendering.
prose_gates.rune: Rune variety/index controls grammar; player_knows_rune and caller selection remain authoritative. Brand/slay duplicate targets share native knowledge, not individual multiplier identity.
